svg.title: Coalesced versus uncoalesced warp stores
svg.desc: For the 64 by 64 GEMM output with 16 by 16 blocks, mapping threadIdx.x to the last axis makes warp 0 store into four fully used 32-byte sectors; mapping it to the first axis scatters the same 32 stores over sixteen sectors, each only a quarter used.
svg.text: lane t: row t // 16, column t % 16
lane t: row t % 16, column t // 16
Same kernel, same data. Only the loop index that the fastest-varying thread id drives has changed.
